description: KNX device operations over the Ext-KNX panel (Opta 4.14+): scan (who is on the line, ~2 s), add (address a.l.d to the list), ping / info / delete / rename (index from myio_knx), program (address: writes the individual address into the ONE device whose programming button is pressed - needs MYIO_WRITE=admin). The answer waits for the result.
name: myio_knx_device
title: KNX devices (without ETS)
